svg.text: Receptionist: strangers, limits, taken messages and notifications
A stranger never reaches memory or tools. The receptionist is a short, tool-free turn on public facts; what it learns becomes a message for the owner.
Telegram or Slack DM from an
Introduces Ava as an AI assistant;
answers only from what the owner
One polite note per hour, then
No linked person for this platform id (trust 1)
On by default. Off, or in a channel: a fixed reply
Default 10 per hour and 30 per day per sender; its own
If not: a fixed reply, and the message is still passed
Sees: the persona, the public profile, public notes,
share labels, an optional away line, and this sender's
own chat. Never sees the owner brief or private notes
The only output besides the reply. Stored as data in
Owner is told, with fixed text
Stranger text never reaches the owner's model. App chat first;
then push, Telegram or Slack by your interrupt-channel choice
Dashboard, People: new, done, dismissed or spam. Settings: on
or off, show first name, public profile
handle, hold, interrupt, defer or verify. An interrupt climbs a
ladder: app at once, a channel after 3 minutes, the other after
5, until you acknowledge. Seen is not acknowledged
Default 22:00 to 07:00; VIPs may break through. Digests are
built in code, no model call
Meera writes: "Can Dana call me about the invoice? It is urgent." The receptionist says the owner is busy and records name,
topic and the claimed urgency. The owner sees a card saying a stranger left a message. Urgency claimed by a stranger is never
trusted: rules and the owner decide.
Strangers cannot link an account by typing a name: "I'm Dana" starts a code challenge sent to Dana's already-linked channel, and
the reply is identical whether or not Dana exists.
